# kion_account_cache (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a Kion AccountCache by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kion_account_cache" "example" {
  # Required
  id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) The ID of the AccountCache to fetch.

### Read-Only

- `account_alias` (String)
- `account_email` (String)
- `account_name` (String)
- `account_number` (String)
- `account_type_id` (Number)
- `car_external_id` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `include_linked_account_spend` (Boolean)
- `linked_account_number` (String)
- `linked_role` (String)
- `payer_id` (Number)
- `service_external_id` (String)
- `skip_access_checking` (Boolean)
